A vampiress taller than her, mid-strike with porcelain fingers curled into claws, flowing obsidian gown trailing like liquid shadow, platinum hair cascading over bare shoulders, eyes burning amber-gold, ivory fangs gleaming beneath crimson lips.

A massive lupine werewolf crouched low, hackles raised along a spine thick as her forearm, midnight-black fur rippling over corded muscle, muzzle dripping saliva, yellow eyes fixed on her throat, hind-legs coiling to pounce.

A cathedral gargoyle twice her height uncoiling from its perch, granite wings spreading fifteen feet wide, obsidian veins threading through weathered stone flesh, carved horns curling backward, vacant eye-sockets igniting with azure flame.

A horned demon-warrior towering over her, crimson skin stretched taut over inhuman musculature, ram-horns spiraling from its temples, clawed hands gripping a blackened greatsword mid-swing, molten-gold eyes burning with ancient malice.

A banshee hovering mid-air, shrieking with mouth stretched impossibly wide, tattered burial shroud billowing in unfelt wind, spectral form flickering between solid and translucent, skeletal fingers reaching toward her face, hair writhing like serpents.

A lich-lord seated on a throne of bones, skeletal hands raised in arcane gesture, emerald flames dancing in hollow eye-sockets, rotted purple robes trimmed with tarnished gold, jeweled crown fused to cracked skull, lips moving in silent incantation.

A ghoul mid-leap with elongated limbs bent at wrong angles, grey flesh pulled tight over protruding ribs, distended jaw hanging open to reveal rows of needle-teeth, hollow eye-sockets weeping black ichor, fingers ending in yellowed talons.

A dark harpy diving from above, obsidian feathers gleaming like wet oil, woman's face beautiful save for the golden raptor-eyes, taloned feet extended to strike, wings spanning twelve feet, muscled legs scaled like a crow's.

A spectral knight in translucent armor, ethereal broadsword raised overhead mid-strike, hollow helmet glowing with pale blue light, tattered phantom-cape streaming behind, chainmail visible beneath frost-covered plate, moving with terrible grace.

An undead black-knight advancing with deliberate steps, animated armor blackened by ancient fire, empty helmet-visor leaking violet mist, gauntleted hands gripping a notched longsword, cape hanging in motionless tatters despite movement, presence radiating cold.

A lamia coiled around a marble pillar, serpentine lower-body scaled in iridescent green, woman's torso emerging bare and pale, emerald eyes slitted vertically, forked tongue tasting air, muscular tail tensing to strike with python-force.

A hellhound the size of a warhorse, smoke rising from charcoal-black fur, eyes burning like forge-coals, fangs long as daggers dripping phosphorescent saliva, shoulders bunched mid-snarl, chain-collar broken and trailing shattered links.

A nosferatu crouched on cathedral stones, bat-like ears flattened against hairless skull, grey skin stretched over angular bones, fingers elongated into spider-legs, mouth opening to reveal concentric rings of teeth, eyes filmed white with hunger.

A massive stone gargoyle perched mid-rooftop, leonine body carved from limestone, wings folded against muscled back, human face frozen in eternal scream, moss growing in the crevices, eyes suddenly flooding with crimson light as it turns.

A succubus floating inches above flagstones, raven-black wings furled behind curved spine, skin pale as moonlight, horns curving gracefully from temples, clawed hands extended in false welcome, lips parted to reveal sharp teeth, eyes violet and hypnotic.

A plague-revenant shambling forward, Renaissance-era clothing rotting into the grey-green flesh beneath, fungal blooms erupting from eye-sockets and mouth, skeletal hands extended with surprising grace, movements deliberate despite visible decay, crowned with withered flowers.

A werewolf frozen mid-transformation, human torso stretching into lupine form, fur erupting through splitting skin, face elongated into snarling muzzle, spine arching backward impossibly, claws extending from fingertips, trapped between man and beast in agonized beauty.

A shadow-demon flowing across stone walls, three-dimensional darkness given predatory form, occasionally solidifying into clawed hands and fanged maw, eyes like stars in void-black mass, moving with liquid grace, reality bending around its presence.

An imp-swarm coalescing into vaguely humanoid shape, dozens of bat-winged creatures clinging together, red skin gleaming, individual faces grinning with needle-fangs, collective form raising a hundred tiny clawed hands, chittering in hellish chorus.

A vampire-lord seated regally, tall even sitting, fingers steepled beneath aristocratic chin, silver-grey hair flowing over velvet coat trimmed in ermine, pale lips curved in knowing smile, sapphire eyes glowing faintly, radiating centuries of patient cruelty.

A fenrir-wolf massive as a cathedral, charcoal fur rippling over mountain-sized shoulders, eyes burning ice-blue, fangs like ivory pillars, breath misting the air with winter cold, head lowering to her level with terrifying intelligence and ancient hate.

A death-knight rising from stone sarcophagus, skeletal form wrapped in ceremonial armor green with verdigris, crown rusted onto skull, empty eye-sockets igniting with pale flame, gauntleted bones gripping a greatsword notched from countless battles.

A giant crow-horror perched on broken tower, glossy black feathers concealing a body too large and wrong, dozens of human eyes blinking from beneath plumage, beak opening to reveal rows of teeth, talons scarring stone beneath its weight.

A bat-swarm spiraling together mid-air, individual creatures merging into humanoid silhouette, wings overlapping into cape-like form, faces pressing together into single visage, red eyes multiplying then combining, vampire-shape solidifying from the living cloud.

A strigoi rising from earth, burial shroud hanging in grey tatters, skin blue-white from grave-cold, lips pulled back from wolf-fangs, fingernails grown into black talons, hair matted with cemetery soil, moving with predatory grace despite death's stiffness.
